phases.name: Pre-Consult Prep
phases.description: Research Phil's current web presence, prepare a simple 1-pager and Starter overview, get the intro from Conrad, and schedule the first call.

swimlanes.name: Research
swimlanes.goal: Know enough about Phil's business and competitors to lead the consult confidently

tasks.title: Search for Phil's current web presence (name + Deer Park land management)
Check WA Secretary of State for business registration and legal name
Find 2–3 local competitor sites to reference on the call
tasks.notes: Brush clearing / defensible space / fire mitigation contractors in Spokane area.

swimlanes.name: Materials
swimlanes.goal: Have something to show Phil so the call feels professional, not like a cold pitch

tasks.title: Prepare Hirobius 1-pager (who we are, who we work with, what we build)
Prepare Starter package one-pager (deliverables, timeline, price range)
tasks.notes: Keep it visual and simple. Phil is a trade guy — bullets, not paragraphs.

tasks.title: Confirm Conrad will make the intro to Phil
tasks.notes: Conrad said on the call: 'I'll send him your way.' Following up to confirm.

tasks.title: Send calendar invite for first consult

phases.name: Initial Consult
phases.description: First call with Phil. Goal: scope the website, agree on Starter package, collect deposit and assets.

swimlanes.name: Intake
swimlanes.goal: Leave the call with everything needed to start building

tasks.title: Confirm company name and Phil's last name
Confirm no domain / email / hosting exists — or note what's there
Collect project photos (or agree on how/when Phil sends them)
Agree on Starter scope: pages, contact form, photo gallery, domain setup
Agree on price and collect deposit
